verdict.rationale: Postman's Workspaces let teams share, version and discover collections/specs (postman-docs-18, postman-docs-21), Spec Hub supports API design/documentation (postman-docs-16/28), and Application Inventory auto-discovers API dependencies (postman-docs-11/32) — all of which support internal API discoverability, and the Postman API Network concept (postman-docs-9) implies a catalog-like construct. However, none of the evidence explicitly documents a dedicated 'internal developer portal' or catalog-publishing feature (e.g., a private API network/catalog product) distinct from general workspace sharing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a purpose-built internal API catalog/portal feature (e.g., Private API Network), evidence of portal customization/branding, and independent confirmation of adoption for internal API discovery use cases.
